brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: Pieces at 0,0,0 half-n, 0,0,1 half-n, 0,0,2 half-n create three levels (get_build), but check_build reports UNSUPPORTED for piece:0,0,2;half-n and piece:2,0,1;full, so upper levels are not properly supported.
drawer:0#0,0#cut at level 0 (south face of half-n) present in get_build.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: No bin on level 2 remains; bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-half-n-full was removed to avoid unsupported load and has not been replaced.

finish.summary: Three-level column exists with bottom drawer, but top bin removed and build has UNSUPPORTED errors on levels 2 and 2,0,1, open faces and loose body.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
